national-alignment.purpose: Skills, programmes and targets tagged to the national strategies they serve, each tag citing its source.

national-alignment-tag.title: National tag
national-alignment-tag.purpose: One national strategy, pillar, goal or group: its definition, sources and the items that serve it.

national-report.title: National alignment report
national-report.purpose: A report by strategy, tag and kind, computed from the data each time: no typed totals.

admin-national-tags.title: National tags
admin-national-tags.purpose: Maintain national tags, their sources and curated links.

national-occupations.title: MoHRE occupation mapping
national-occupations.purpose: Every current role with an occupation label, a code only when verified, and an indicative national skill level.

national-emirati-pipeline.title: Emirati pipeline by competency
national-emirati-pipeline.purpose: Emirati-ready successors, progression into authorised roles and retention for critical and future roles, by competency area; aggregate only.

my-future-wallet.title: My Future Skills Wallet
my-future-wallet.purpose: The core five future skills, computed from your evidence, linked to your development plan.

national-future-wallet.title: Future Skills Wallet counter
national-future-wallet.purpose: Staff holding the complete core-five wallet, against the dated target leadership set.

scope.direct: Direct: the source describes the strategy
scope.indirect: Indirect: the source mentions it in another context

src.recheck: Re-check the source before external reporting

derive.future_group: Skills are linked from their Jahiz group in the skills catalogue (FS02)
derive.cec_net_zero: CleanEnergyComp competences marked Net Zero are linked automatically (FS41)

measure.org_share: at Practitioner or above · target {target}% by {due}
measure.family_share: of the family at level {target} or above
measure.wallet_share: with the complete wallet · target {target}% by {due}

reason.curated: Linked by the HR director or an admin to {tag}, with the note shown
reason.futureGroup: Derived from the data: the skill sits in the Jahiz group {group} in the skills catalogue
reason.netZero: Derived from the data: the CleanEnergyComp competence is marked Net Zero 2050
reason.inactive: The linked row is no longer active (retired, draft or obsolete); it stays visible
reason.missing: The linked row was not found

none: No national alignment data to show.

hub.intro: Every skill, programme and target can carry the national strategy it serves. Reports are filters over the live data: nothing on this page is typed or stored.

tile.strategiesSub: {n} tags with pillars, goals and groups
tile.programmesSub: courses, pathways, credentials, talent and leadership

hub.strategiesIntro: Counts are computed from the links each time the page opens.
hub.matrixIntro: Distinct linked items per strategy, including its pillars, goals and groups.
hub.jahizIntro: Read from the Jahiz group column of the skills catalogue (FS02), never re-entered.
hub.jahizNote: Nuclear safety and operational excellence is ENEC's own fifth group; it is not a national tag.

notGov.title: Kafa'a is not a government system
notGov.body: Tags are ENEC's internal alignment for planning and reporting. They cite public sources but are not a government classification, a submission or an endorsement by any authority. A tag flagged for re-checking cites a secondary or indirect source.

tag.intro: The definition, sources and the items that serve this tag, computed from the data.
tag.retired: This tag is retired and no longer appears in reports.
tag.reportIntro: Live items with their status and the reason they are linked; measures for HR and admins, suppressed under 10.
tag.reachSub: distinct staff with counted evidence on a linked skill
tag.reachHidden: measures are for HR and admins

report.intro: Choose a strategy, a tag and a kind. The report filters the live data each time: change the data and the report follows.
report.computed: {n} items, computed from the data just now
report.caption: Linked items
report.itemsIntro: Every row explains why it is linked; inactive rows stay visible.
report.noMeasures: Measures (people counts) are shown to HR and admins only.

export.header: Kafa'a national alignment report: computed from the data at export time; not an official return; measures SIMULATED; counts under 10 suppressed

admin.intro: Maintain the national tags and their curated links. Checks run live; source tiers are computed from the link; every save is audited.
admin.preview: How the source standing will read
admin.checkOkBody: The tag passes the same checks the server runs.
admin.confirmEdit: Save the changes to this tag?
admin.consequence: The tag changes every report that filters by it. The save is audited; adding or retiring a tag is also recorded in the NEXUS ledger.
admin.derivedTitle: Some links come from the data

derived.future_group: Skills in this Jahiz group are linked from the skills catalogue. To change them, change the skill's Jahiz group there.
derived.cec_net_zero: CleanEnergyComp competences marked Net Zero are linked automatically. Other items can be linked here.

admin.confirmLink: Link this item to the tag?
admin.linkConsequence: The item appears in every report for this tag. The change is audited.
admin.unlinkConsequence: The link is deactivated, not removed, and leaves the reports at once. The change is audited.

tag.strategy: Choose one of the six national strategies (the strategy and kind of a saved tag do not change).
tag.kind: Choose strategy, pillar, goal or group.
tag.parent: A pillar, goal or group sits under the active strategy-level tag of the same strategy.
tag.code: Use a code of 2 to 24 capital letters, digits or hyphens.
tag.name: Give a name of 2 to 120 characters in English and in Arabic.
tag.summary: Give a summary of 20 to 600 characters in English and in Arabic.
tag.clean: Tag text may not state headcounts or site information.
tag.typed_total: Tag text may name years but no typed number: reports compute every total from the data.
tag.sources: Give one to five sources, each with a label, an https link and an as-of date that is not in the future.
tag.horizon: Use a horizon year from 2022 to 2100.
tag.scope: The source scope is direct or indirect.

link.table: Choose a skill, competence, programme, pathway, credential or target.
link.derived: This link is derived from the data (Jahiz group or Net Zero competence): change the data, not the tag.
link.security: Security skills stay at career-path level and are not tagged.
link.note: Write a note of 10 to 300 characters in English and in Arabic.
link.clean: Link notes may not state headcounts or site information.
link.typed_total: Link notes may name years but no typed number.

ro.concept: Concept roles get no occupation code or level.
ro.label: Give an occupation label of 3 to 120 characters in English and in Arabic.
ro.clean: Labels and rationales may not state numbers, headcounts or site information.
ro.level: Choose a skill level from 1 to 5.
ro.basis: Use the education-rule level, or choose "reviewed" with a rationale.
ro.rationale: A reviewed level needs a rationale of 10 to 400 characters in English and in Arabic.

code.code: Use a code of 2 to 16 capital letters, digits, dots or hyphens, copied from the source.
code.source: Give a source label and an https link.
code.host: The source must be an official UAE government page (u.ae or a gov.ae domain).
code.date: Give the date the source was read, not in the future.

ro.intro: Each current role carries a national occupation label and an indicative skill level; a MoHRE code appears only when verified from an official source.

notMohre.title: Kafa'a is not a MoHRE system
notMohre.body: This is ENEC's internal mapping for reporting. Kafa'a does not issue, validate or submit occupational classifications or work permits. Codes are shown only when copied from an official MoHRE or UAE government source; every other role reads "code pending review". Skill levels are Kafa'a's indicative estimate until reviewed.

tile.rolesSub: current roles; concept roles get no code
tile.classificationSub: in the national classification, grouped into {levels} skill levels

ro.tableIntro: Labels are proposed for review; codes stay pending until an admin records one from an official page.
ro.ruleTitle: How the indicative level is set
ro.ruleBody: Kafa'a's own rule, pending review, from the role's entry education: a degree gives level 1, a diploma level 2 and secondary school level 3 (1 is the highest qualification requirement). Levels 4 and 5 are not used by ENEC roles in this demo. HR can review a level with a rationale.
ro.saveConsequence: The label and level change the mapping table and the uplift trend. The save is audited.
ro.clearTitle: Return the code of {role} to pending review
ro.verifyRuleTitle: Only codes copied from an official page
ro.verifyRuleBody: Copy the code exactly from an official MoHRE or UAE government page (u.ae or a gov.ae domain) and give the date you read it. Press articles never verify a code. The person who last edited this mapping cannot verify it.
ro.makerChecker: You last edited this mapping, so another admin must verify its code.
ro.verifyConsequence: The code appears on the mapping with its source. The action is audited and recorded in the NEXUS ledger.
ro.confirmClear: Return this code to pending review?
ro.clearConsequence: The code is hidden and the role reads "code pending review". The action is audited and recorded in the NEXUS ledger.
ro.trendIntro: The synthetic workforce by indicative skill level at each year end. Every cell under 10 is suppressed.
ro.trendNote: SIMULATED: synthetic staff counted at their current role's level from their hire date; role moves and leavers are not modelled, so the trend shows the hiring mix. {roles} roles mapped; cells under {min} suppressed.

ep.intro: Emiratisation by competency, not a tally of staff: do the critical and future roles have Emirati-ready successors, and do people stay and progress into authorised roles?
ep.aggBody: Every figure is a count over a group. Any group under {min} people shows <10. Nationality is used for this report only and never enters any score or ranking.
ep.none: No pipeline is available for your role.

tile.successorsSub: {pct} of internal successors on the slates
tile.readySub: {n} of {of} roles have an Emirati-ready successor
tile.readySubSup: role coverage suppressed ({n} roles in scope)

ep.readyIntro: Cumulative: successors expected ready on or before each date, from the readiness band and months on the succession slate.
ep.readyNote: A person on two slates counts once, at their best band and earliest date. External emergency cover is not a successor.
ep.retentionIntro: Of the people hired into these roles at least that long ago, the share still employed at that point.
ep.retentionNote: A rate is shown only when its cohort and the people retained are both 10 or more.
ep.areasIntro: Each competency area is the job family of the critical and future roles in it.
ep.areasNote: <10 means the group has fewer than {min} people; the value is withheld, never estimated.
ep.progressionIntro: Emirati staff authorised in a regulated critical or future role, by year.
ep.mirrorStatusBody: Authorisation dates mirror the licensee's own records. Kafa'a does not issue, hold or confirm any licence or authorisation.
ep.rolesIntro: Critical roles, and roles whose current published outlook is growing. Concept roles and security roles are not included.

method.roles: Roles: current roles that are critical (the role record or a critical succession slate) or whose current outlook label is growing.
method.successors: Successors: internal, proposed or confirmed successors on each role's latest slate who are active staff; HR's readiness first, otherwise the computed one.
method.readyBy: Ready-by date: today for ready now; otherwise the proposal date plus the months on the slate (24 or 60 when none is given).
method.authorised: Authorised: an authorisation date in the HR mirror within the last 36 months; mirror status only.
method.retention: Retention at N months: hired at least N months ago and not left before N months.
method.suppression: Any count under {min} is withheld; a share needs both its count and its base at {min} or more.
method.protected: Nationality is read only to build this aggregate. No engine reads it and no person is scored with it.

reason.roles: {n} critical or future roles in this area, {slates} with a succession slate
reason.suppressed: Emirati successors are fewer than {min}, so the counts are withheld
reason.successors: {n} Emirati successors on the latest slates
reason.retention: {pct}% of Emirati hires were still employed after 36 months
reason.mirror: Retention and authorisations come from the SIMULATED HR mirror

fw.intro: Five future skills every member of staff can hold. Each one counts only when your records show the evidence; a self-rating never counts.
fw.none: The wallet is for staff with a skills profile.
fw.evidenceOnly: Computed from evidence only: verified, evidenced or validated records and in-date credentials.
fw.targetLine: Organisation target: {pct} of staff with the complete wallet by {date}.
fw.addPlan: Add {n} open items to my plan
fw.allInPlan: Open items are already in my plan
fw.noPlanYet: No open development plan yet: adding items starts a draft.
fw.itemsIntro: Each item shows its rule, your evidence and where to earn it.
fw.confirmTitle: Add the open items to your development plan?
fw.confirmBody: {n} activities are added to your open development plan, due {date}. Nothing already in the plan is added twice.

detail.coreNone: No core skill with evidence yet.

ai_rung2.title: AI fluency rung 2
ai_rung2.rule: Practitioner or above on the AI fluency ladder, from evidence in every dimension.

cyber_hygiene.title: Cyber hygiene
cyber_hygiene.rule: The cyber hygiene micro-credential, awarded and in date. Awareness only.

plant_data.title: Plant-data basics
plant_data.rule: Digital tools and data literacy at level 1 or above, with evidence.

core_skill.title: One critical core skill
core_skill.rule: Any one of the nuclear critical core skills at level 2 or above, with evidence.

cec_l1.title: CleanEnergyComp level 1
cec_l1.rule: Level 1 or above in every CleanEnergyComp area, from evidence.
cec_l1.next: Go to my clean energy profile

fw.targetIntro: A dated target set by leadership, shown as a parameter beside the measured counter.
fw.targetBy: of staff with the complete wallet by {date}
fw.notClaimBody: The target is a demo leadership decision. It states no external commitment and no national figure.

ai_rung2.met: Your evidence puts you at rung {level}: Practitioner or above
ai_rung2.open: Your evidence puts you at rung {level}; rung 2 needs evidence in every dimension

cyber_hygiene.met: An awarded, in-date cyber hygiene micro-credential
cyber_hygiene.open: No awarded, in-date cyber hygiene micro-credential

plant_data.met: Data literacy at level {level} from counted evidence
plant_data.open: No counted evidence of data literacy at level 1 yet

core_skill.met: A critical core skill at level {level} from counted evidence
core_skill.open: Your strongest core skill with evidence is at level {level}; level 2 is needed

cec_l1.open: CleanEnergyComp level {level}: every area needs level 1

reason.evidenceOnly: Only verified, evidenced or validated records count; self-ratings never do

fwc.intro: How many staff hold the complete core-five wallet, against the dated target leadership set. Computed from evidence each time; nothing is typed.
fwc.none: The counter is for HR and platform admins.
fwc.counterIntro: Active staff with all five items, against the leadership target.
fwc.supBody: Fewer than {min} people hold the complete wallet today, so the count and share are withheld. The items below show where the gap is.
fwc.definitionNote: From evidence only: self-ratings never count. Every count under 10 is suppressed.
fwc.itemsIntro: Share of active staff holding each of the five items; the line marks the target value.
fwc.distIntro: How many of the five items people hold.
fwc.famIntro: Share of each family holding each item; families under {min} people, and security, safeguards and cyber, are not broken out.
fwc.famNone: No family is large enough to show.
fwc.whoSets: Only the HR director sets the target.
fwc.setIntro: A leadership decision: the value and date are saved with your name and the time, and the earlier setting is kept.

problem.pct: Use a whole percentage from 1 to 100.
problem.due: Choose a date after today and no later than the end of 2035.
problem.note: Write a note of 10 to 300 characters in English and in Arabic.
problem.clean: The note may not state headcounts or site information.

fwc.confirmTitle: Set the Future Skills Wallet target?
fwc.confirmBody: The organisation target becomes {pct}% of staff by {date}. It is recorded with your name, audited and written to the NEXUS ledger.
